name: Inncafe
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Inncafe in Kufstein!**

Discover the cozy charm of **Tirol**’s historic town at our **Inncafe**, where traditional Tyrolean hospitality meets modern comfort. Nestled in the heart of **Kufstein**, just a short stroll from the majestic **Kufstein Fortress**, we invite you to savor the flavors of the region in a warm, inviting atmosphere.

Indulge in our **Kaiserschmarrn**—fluffy, caramelized shreds of pancake, dusted with powdered sugar and served with fresh fruit or apricot jam. Pair it with a steaming cup of **Tiroler Bergkäse** soup or a hearty **Schweinsbraten** (roast pork) with **Krautsalat** and **Knödel**. For coffee lovers, our **Melange** or **Einspänner** (a rich, whipped-cream-topped coffee) will hit the spot.

After your meal, take a leisurely walk along the **Inn River** or explore the charming old town with its colorful **Fachwerkhäuser** (half-timbered houses). In winter, enjoy the festive atmosphere of **Kufstein**’s Christmas markets or glide across the nearby **Erlebnisbad Kufstein**’s ice rink.

Whether you’re here for a quick break, a romantic getaway, or a family adventure, **Inncafe** is your perfect stop in **Tirol**. **Willkommen in Kufstein!**
